{{Top|leg|canon=Tomuon-cloth}}
'''Tomuon cloth''' was a strong, yet soft and wrinkle-resistant fabric made from the wool of the [[Tomuon]] of [[Askaji/Legends|Askaj]].

Tomuon cloth was a high-demand luxury item as far away as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and was the Askajians principle export. This cloth was so valued, that Askajian tribes where known to fight wars over the services of especially skilled weavers.
